gloss: to apply; to be applicable; to fall under; to qualify

definitions.gloss: to apply; to be applicable; to fall under; to qualify
definitions.explanation: To meet the relevant criteria or conditions; to be included in a certain category or classification. Common in formal, legal, and administrative contexts.

examples.japanese: {条件|じょうけん}に{該当|がいとう}する{方|かた}はお{申|もう}し{出|で}ください。
examples.english: Those who meet the conditions, please come forward.

examples.japanese: {以下|いか}のいずれかに{該当|がいとう}する{場合|ばあい}は、ご{連絡|れんらく}ください。
examples.english: Please contact us if any of the following applies.

examples.japanese: この{規定|きてい}は{我々|われわれ}には{該当|がいとう}しないと{判断|はんだん}した。
examples.english: We determined that this regulation does not apply to us.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜に{該当|がいとう}する: to fall under ~; to apply to ~
- 〜が{該当|がいとう}する: ~ applies/qualifies
- {該当|がいとう}しない: not applicable; does not apply
- {該当|がいとう}する{場合|ばあい}: when applicable; if this applies

Frequently seen on official forms, regulations, and notices. Often appears as 「{該当|がいとう}する{項目|こうもく}に{丸|まる}をつけてください」 (Please circle the applicable item).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {当|あ}てはまる: to apply; to fit — more everyday; used for general matching
- {適用|てきよう}する: to apply (a rule, law, etc.) — used when actively applying something
